Aisha (release): Heads-up: EU canary started surfacing OOMs on long-context jobs for llama3-q after runtime 3.3.0 rolled last night. Proposing a short regional soft-pin to 3.2.1 while runtime investigates.
Marco (runtime): Confirmed. Longseq telem shows KV cache eviction loop sometimes double-freeing pages under high concurrency. Hypothesis: new kernel opts changed eviction ordering.
Devin (qa): I reproduced locally with seq=30k, 6 parallel clients. Crash trace: ```
E runtime/kv_cache.cc:212 eviction: free() on invalid pointer
E runtime/worker.cc:132 - abort() called
```
Sam (infra): If we pin regionally, watch capacity. eu-west has two pools; pin may shift load to older nodes. I'll monitor autoscaler and queues.
Priya (sdk): We need to ensure hosted routing honors model_family->{runtime} mapping. I can push an override rule scoped to region=eu-west + label so Console/UIs show it. Also will emit an audit event.
Aisha (release): Proposed plan: (1) apply a 2-hour soft-pin of runtime=3.2.1 for model_family=llama3-q in eu-west; (2) SDK team applies routing override + console label; (3) runtime team runs targeted triage and produces RCA; (4) QA runs smoke and perf eval; (5) if we need longer window, notify CS and schedule customer comms. Any objections?
Marco (runtime): Fine. I'll run a small canary eval (50 requests: mix of 2k/8k/30k sequences) after pin. Will report latencies and crashes.
Devin (qa): I'll run a load sweep and attachment with trimmed logs.
Priya (sdk): I'll push override now and include rollback hook.
Aisha (release): deploybot, schedule pin rollout in 3m with 5m cooldown, include rollback playbook link: https://go/internal/runbooks/runtime-pin-rollback
deploybot: Received pin request:
  action: soft-pin
  runtime: 3.2.1
  model_filter: family=llama3-q
  region: eu-west
  window: 2h
  cooldown: 5m
  initiated_by: Aisha (release)
deploybot: Running preflight checks...
ci-bot: Preflight results: routing health OK; capacity headroom: 22% in eu-west; no pending hotfixes.
Priya (sdk): Override applied. Console label: "eu-west-runtime-pin-6145002222"; audit id: d4f5e6.
Sam (infra): Watching autoscaler and node pressure. No spike yet.
Marco (runtime): Canary eval complete: 50 reqs, median latency +6ms vs baseline, p95 +18ms, no crashes. KV metrics show stable eviction rates.
Devin (qa): Load sweep post-pin: 0 crashes at 10m, mem stable. Uploading logs to the ticket.
Aisha (release): Thanks. I'll draft a short blurb for incidents and release notes: note regional mitigation and that a runtime fix is TBD.
Priya (sdk): Filed follow-up: SDK routing enhancement to automatically surface regional pins and offer automated rollback after window (TICK-824).
Marco (runtime): Triage next steps: instrument eviction ordering, add additional asserts to catch double-free, and prepare a 3.3.1 hotfix if needed.
Aisha (release): OK closing for now; leave triage channel open and escalate if any new crashes appear. :white_check_mark:
